Author: jFray
Name: EchoMix
Description: An interactive DJ deck with live mixing tools, custom playlists, and a synced listener mode with an audio visualizer.
Punchline: Spin tracks and let the party sync in.
Changelog: Fixed deleting a song from a playlist leaving its file behind - re-uploading the same file afterward no longer gets renamed with a "(2)". Fixed the DJ Deck visualizer shifting down slightly the moment a track with a known BPM loaded. Added a toast (with a toggle in General settings, under Notifications) that lets a host know when someone joins their show, public or private.
